segment_contamination_dimensions: Non-wooden material security cabins (MS, FRP, GRP, GI, PUF panel, PVC, aluminium) — buyers searching those materials are served by sibling MCATs (MS Security Cabins, FRP Portable Security Cabin, GI Portable Cabin, PUF Cabin, PVC Portable Cabin) and must not be attracted by wooden-specific names

General-purpose portable office or accommodation cabins (Office Cabin, Prefabricated Accommodation, Modular Portable Cabin) — buyer persona is workspace/living use, not security guard post deployment; names must not imply office or residential habitation use

Toll booth and ATM cabin buyers (Toll Booth, Portable ATM Cabin) — these are specialised infrastructure deployments with different procurement channels and buyer personas; names must not imply toll or banking infrastructure use
